answer_1.quote: We focus on the problem of automatically describing atomic units of computation in LLMs called features... producing a human-understandable description text s_f of the feature f.

answer_2.quote: We propose to evaluate how faithful a description is to its corresponding feature with the following complementary metrics... Input-based Evaluation... Output-based Evaluation

answer_3.quote: we feed s_f concatenated with T_f, T_f′ and T_f′′ to a judge LLM... and task it to indicate which of the three sets matches s_f
methods: set matching based on description alignment

answer_4.quote: we conducted two human evaluations... we tasked human annotators (6 graduate students) with scoring their faithfulness with respect to (a) input-faithfulness: what activates the feature and (b) output-faithfulness: how the feature affects the model's outputs
answer_4.guideline: annotators were instructed to assess whether the description accurately reflects what inputs activate the feature and how the feature influences model outputs
